mole.engine.schedulers module¶

mole.engine.schedulers.get_constant_schedule_with_warmup(optimizer, num_warmup_steps, last_epoch=-1) → LambdaLR[source]¶

Create a schedule with a constant learning rate preceded by a warmup period during which the learning rate increases linearly between 0 and the initial lr set in the optimizer. :param optimizer: The optimizer for which to schedule the learning rate. :type optimizer: [~torch.optim.Optimizer] :param num_warmup_steps: The number of steps for the warmup phase. :type num_warmup_steps: int :param last_epoch: The index of the last epoch when resuming training. :type last_epoch: int, optional, defaults to -1

Returns:

torch.optim.lr_scheduler.LambdaLR with the appropriate schedule.

mole.engine.schedulers.get_linear_schedule_with_warmup(optimizer, num_warmup_steps, num_training_steps, last_epoch=-1) → LambdaLR[source]¶

Create a schedule with a learning rate that decreases linearly from the initial lr set in the optimizer to 0, after a warmup period during which it increases linearly from 0 to the initial lr set in the optimizer. :param optimizer: The optimizer for which to schedule the learning rate. :type optimizer: [~torch.optim.Optimizer] :param num_warmup_steps: The number of steps for the warmup phase. :type num_warmup_steps: int :param num_training_steps: The total number of training steps. :type num_training_steps: int :param last_epoch: The index of the last epoch when resuming training. :type last_epoch: int, optional, defaults to -1

Returns:

torch.optim.lr_scheduler.LambdaLR with the appropriate schedule.
